title: Keep the pair readable
description: A color proof recomputes its paired ink as the surface changes, preserving an unrounded contrast target within a bounded palette.
useCase: Explore theme colors while preserving a text contrast relationship, or show why a restricted palette cannot meet it.
interaction: Choose a surface swatch or open the color well. Lock contrast to recompute ink; unlock it to keep the ink fixed as the surface changes.
reducedMotion: Every color edit applies immediately; no hue tween passes through unverified intermediate contrasts. Inactive hosts disable all inputs.
limitations: sRGB WCAG contrast calculation, not APCA or a full accessibility audit. Ink is searched on a fixed 225-degree, 18%-saturation HSL axis in 1,001 samples. Impossible polarity or lightness bounds show an explicit unavailable state.
look: Full-bleed persimmon Arial specimen with oversized Aa, a small pangram, exact ink value and a neutral color-mixing strip.
motion: A surface edit recomputes and applies the paired ink immediately. Unlocking freezes the current ink; relocking resolves from the newest surface. The ratio display floors to two decimals instead of rounding a failing pair up.
adapt: `luminance` and `contrast` implement the sRGB contrast calculation. `solveInk` finds a bounded foreground on the fixed `ink` axis. Change `SWATCHES` for surface presets, and `DEFAULT_CONFIG` or the `config` prop for the minimum ratio and palette limits.
